nodes.label: Optional Export Flags
nodes.rationale: Wiki, Neo4j, FalkorDB, SVG, GraphML, and MCP each run only on their own flag; the token-reduction benchmark runs only above 5,000 words because for small corpora the value is structural clarity, not compression. Neo4j and FalkorDB pushes use MERGE so they are safe to re-run. The wiki export must precede Step 9 cleanup while the labels sidecar still exists.

nodes.label: graphify MCP Server
nodes.rationale: A stdio MCP server exposing query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, and shortest_path so other agents can query the graph live. Client config must use the absolute interpreter path, since Claude Desktop cannot run command substitution and a uv-installed graphify is not importable from the system python3.

edges.source_location: set command to the absolute interpreter path printed by .graphify_python
